items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I remember I even gave him a couple of arrangements.

ctx.x: I remember Benny Goodman used to go and listen, but he never sat in.
Well, I never saw Benny there, but --
I don't mean at that particular place, but I mean uptown at sessions, I've heard musicians say that Benny Goodman used to go and listen but he never played.
